title: Hanuma began to narrate story of to Seetha
introduction: Sitting on the branch of a Simshapa tree, Hanuma began to narrate in human language the story of Rama from the time he was born till his sending Hanuma to Lanka in search of Seetha. Hearing the narration of Hanuman, Seetha was overjoyed and finds Hanuma perched on Simshapa tree.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 31st Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic

verses.devanagari:
एवम् बहु विधाम् चिन्ताम् चिन्तयित्व महाकपिः |
संश्रवे मधुरम् वाक्यम् वैदेह्या व्याजहार ह
verses.iast:
evam bahu vidhām cintām cintayitva mahākapiḥ |
saṃśrave madhuram vākyam vaidehyā vyājahāra ha
verses.translation: Thus reflecting on many kinds of thought, Hanuma spoke the following sweet words within the hearing range of Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
राजा दशरथो नाम रथ कुन्जर वाजिनाम् |
पुण्य शीलो महाकीर्तिः ऋजुः आसीन् महायशाः
verses.iast:
rājā daśaratho nāma ratha kunjara vājinām |
puṇya śīlo mahākīrtiḥ ṛjuḥ āsīn mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: "There was a king named Dasaratha who was very glorious among the kings of Ikshvaku dynasty and had a virtuous disposition. He owned chariots, elephants and horses, becoming very famous.

glosses.meaning: among kings belonging to Ikshvaku dynasty

verses.devanagari:
राजर्षीणां गुणश्रेष्ठस्तपसा चर्षिभिः समः |
चक्र वर्ति कुले जातः पुरम् दर समो बले
verses.iast:
rājarṣīṇāṃ guṇaśreṣṭhastapasā carṣibhiḥ samaḥ |
cakra varti kule jātaḥ puram dara samo bale
verses.translation: "He was excellent in virtues among royal sages. He was equal to the seven sages in austerity. He was born in the lineage of emperors and was equivalent to Indra in prowess."

verses.devanagari:
अहिंसा रतिः अक्षुद्रो घृणी सत्य पराक्रमः |
मुख्यः च इक्ष्वाकु वंशस्य लक्ष्मीवाम्ल् लक्ष्मि वर्धनः
verses.iast:
ahiṃsā ratiḥ akṣudro ghṛṇī satya parākramaḥ |
mukhyaḥ ca ikṣvāku vaṃśasya lakṣmīvāml lakṣmi vardhanaḥ
verses.translation: "He was keen on harmlessness. He was not vulgar. He was compassionate. He was truly mighty. He was an eminent king in Ikshvaku race. He was endowed with prosperity and was causing to increase prosperity."

verses.devanagari:
पार्थिव व्यञ्जनैः युक्तः पृथु श्रीः पार्थिव ऋषभः |
पृथिव्याम् चतुः अन्तयाम् विश्रुतः सुखदः सुखी
verses.iast:
pārthiva vyañjanaiḥ yuktaḥ pṛthu śrīḥ pārthiva ṛṣabhaḥ |
pṛthivyām catuḥ antayām viśrutaḥ sukhadaḥ sukhī
verses.translation: "The king Dasaratha was endowed with royal characteristics, highly prosperous, excellent among kings and highly prosperous, excellent among kings and famous on earth with its four borders. He was happy man and gave happiness to others."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य पुत्रः प्रियो ज्येष्ठः तारा अधिप निभ आननः |
रामो नाम विशेषज्ञः श्रेष्ठः सर्व धनुष्मताम्
verses.iast:
tasya putraḥ priyo jyeṣṭhaḥ tārā adhipa nibha ānanaḥ |
rāmo nāma viśeṣajñaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarva dhanuṣmatām
verses.translation: "There was an eldest son named Rama to that Dasaratha. Rama was beloved having a moon-like face. He, knows the distinctions among humans and others. He was excellent among all the wielders of the bow."

glosses.meaning: named Rama priyaH = who was beloved
having a face like a moon
among all the wielders of the bow.

verses.devanagari:
रक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य स्व जनस्य अपि रक्षिता |
रक्षिता जीव लोकस्य धर्मस्य च परम् तपः
verses.iast:
rakṣitā svasya vṛttasya sva janasya api rakṣitā |
rakṣitā jīva lokasya dharmasya ca param tapaḥ
verses.translation: "That Rama who annihilates enemies, is a protector of his own mode of life, a protector of his own people, a protector of every living being and a protector of righteousness."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य सत्य अभिसंधस्य वृद्धस्य वचनात् पितुः |
सभार्यः सह च भ्रात्रा वीरः प्रव्रजितो वनम्
verses.iast:
tasya satya abhisaṃdhasya vṛddhasya vacanāt pituḥ |
sabhāryaḥ saha ca bhrātrā vīraḥ pravrajito vanam
verses.translation: "By the command of that Dasaratha, his old father and true-speaking man, that Rama a brave man went on exile to a forest along with his wife and brother."

verses.devanagari:
तेन तत्र महाअरण्ये मृगयाम् परिधावता |
राक्षसा निहताः शूरा बहवः कामरूपिणः
verses.iast:
tena tatra mahāaraṇye mṛgayām paridhāvatā |
rākṣasā nihatāḥ śūrā bahavaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "While hunting in that forest, that Rama killed many demons who were valiant and who could assume any form at will."

glosses.meaning: and who could assume any form at will

verses.devanagari:
जन स्थान वधम् श्रुत्वा हतौ च खर दूषणौ |
ततः तु अमर्ष अपहृता जानकी रावणेन तु
वञ्चयित्वा वने रामं मृगरूपेण मायया |
verses.iast:
jana sthāna vadham śrutvā hatau ca khara dūṣaṇau |
tataḥ tu amarṣa apahṛtā jānakī rāvaṇena tu
vaJṇcayitvā vane rāmaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa māyayā |
verses.translation: "Thereafter, hearing about the killing of demons in Janasthana, a part of Dandaka forest, in addition to killing of Khara and Dushana the demons, the enraged Ravana took away, Seetha, by deceiving Rama in creating an illusive image of deer in the forest."

glosses.meaning: about the killing of demons in Janasthana a part of Dandaka forest
in the guise of a deer

verses.devanagari:
स मार्गमाणस्ताम् देवीम् रामः सीतामन्न्दिताम्
आससाद वने मित्रम् सुग्रीवम् नाम वानरम् |
verses.iast:
sa mārgamāṇastām devīm rāmaḥ sītāmannditām
āsasāda vane mitram sugrīvam nāma vānaram |
verses.translation: "Searching for Seetha the irreproachable lady, that Rama met a monkey called Sugreeva as his friend in the forest."

glosses.meaning: that Rama parapuramjayaH = the conqueror of enemys cities

verses.devanagari:
ततः स वालिनम् ह्त्वा रामः परपुरम्जयः
प्रायच्छत्कपिराज्यम् तत्सुग्रीवाय महाबलः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa vālinam htvā rāmaḥ parapuramjayaḥ
prāyacchatkapirājyam tatsugrīvāya mahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: "Thereafter, Rama the conqueror of enemy's cities and very strong man, killed Vali and gave away that kingdom of monkeys to Sugreeva."

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेणापि संदिष्टा हरयः कामरूपिणः
दिक्षु सर्वासु ताम् देवीम् विचिन्न्वन्ति सहस्रशः |
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇāpi sandiṣṭā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
dikṣu sarvāsu tām devīm vicinnvanti sahasraśaḥ |
verses.translation: "As commanded and sent by Sugreeva, thousands of monkeys capable of assuming form at their will, are searching for that lady Seetha in all quarters of the earth."

glosses.meaning: capable of assuming any form at their will

verses.devanagari:
अहम् सम्पातिवचनाच्छतयोजनमायतम्
अस्या हेतोर्विशालाक्ष्याः सागरं वेगवान् प्लुतः |
verses.iast:
aham sampātivacanācchatayojanamāyatam
asyā hetorviśālākṣyāḥ sāgaraṃ vegavān plutaḥ |
verses.translation: "By the words of Sampati, I a swift monkey crossed the ocean having a length of one hundred yojanas for the sake of this broad eyed Seetha."

glosses.meaning: for the sake of this broad eyed Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
यथा रूपाम् यथा वर्णाम् यथा लक्ष्मीम् विनिश्चिताम्
अश्रौषम् राघवस्य अहम् सा इयम् आसादिता मया |
verses.iast:
yathā rūpām yathā varṇām yathā lakṣmīm viniścitām
aśrauṣam rāghavasya aham sā iyam āsāditā mayā |
verses.translation: "This Seetha has been found by me according to the same comeliness, complexion and the bodily marks as I had heard from Rama."

glosses.meaning: and according to the bodily marks

verses.devanagari:
विरराम एवम् उक्त्वा असौ वाचम् वानर पुम्गवः
जानकी च अपि तत् श्रुत्वा विस्मयम् परमम् गता |
verses.iast:
virarāma evam uktvā asau vācam vānara pumgavaḥ
jānakī ca api tat śrutvā vismayam paramam gatā |
verses.translation: Having spoken these words, Hanuma kept quiet. Hearing those words, Seetha too got a great surprise.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सा वक्र केश अन्ता सुकेशी केश सम्वृतम्
उन्नम्य वदनम् भीरुः शिंशपा वृक्षम् ऐक्षत |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sā vakra keśa antā sukeśī keśa samvṛtam
unnamya vadanam bhīruḥ śiṃśapā vṛkṣam aikṣata |
verses.translation: Thereafter, that Seetha whose consciousness was enshrouded by affliction, whose hair-ends were curved and who was of a fearful nature, lifted her face and looked towards Shimshupa tree.

glosses.meaning: whose conciousness was enshrouded by affliction
and who was of fearful nature

verses.devanagari:
निशम्य सीता वचनम् कपेश्च |
दिशश्च सर्वाः प्रदिशश्च वीक्ष्य |
स्वयम् प्रहर्षं परमं जगाम |
सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती
verses.iast:
niśamya sītā vacanam kapeśca |
diśaśca sarvāḥ pradiśaśca vīkṣya |
svayam praharṣaṃ paramaṃ jagāma |
sarvātmanā rāmamanusmarantī
verses.translation: Hearing Hanuma's words and looking at all quarters and sub-quarters, Seetha was recollecting Rama in all ways and obtained a great joy.

verses.devanagari:
सा तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् च तथा अपि अधस्तान् |
निरीक्षमाणा तम् अचिन्त्य बुद्धिम् |
ददर्श पिन्ग अधिपतेः अमात्यम् |
वात आत्मजम् सूर्यम् इव उदयस्थम्
verses.iast:
sā tiryag ūrdhvam ca tathā api adhastān |
nirīkṣamāṇā tam acintya buddhim |
dadarśa pinga adhipateḥ amātyam |
vāta ātmajam sūryam iva udayastham
verses.translation: Looking at sides, up and down, that Seetha saw that Hanuman, the sun of wind-god, having an unimaginable intelligence, the minister of Sugreeva and looking like the sun behind an eastern mountain.
